# Pitch-model golden for opensvr-voice (Phase 5, pitch stage).
# Re-dumped with the Rust PitchModel (a bit-exact port of the C++ f0model-dds
# path) against the GUMI AI voice. The pitch feature z-score follows OpenSV+
# ((value - mean) / standard deviation); the C++ fork multiplied by the
# deviation, which left the network input out of range.
# The voice archive itself is proprietary and stays behind
# OPENSVR_TEST_VOICE; only these small text goldens are committed.
# Input lines start with "in " (<language> <midi> <seconds> <phoneme>...),
# followed by the timing stage's real predicted durations and the expected
# per-frame absolute MIDI pitch (5 ms grid from time zero).
in japanese 31 0.45 k a
in japanese 33 0.55 s a
durations 4
japanese k 0 0 0.11097769439220428
japanese a 0 0 0.12925316393375397
japanese s 1 0 0.20976915955543518
japanese a 1 1 0.55000001192092896
